	// this node.
	In, Out [EdgeMap](https://pkg.go.dev#EdgeMap)
}
    Node is an entry on a profiling report. It represents a unique program location.

AddToEdge increases the weight of an edge between two nodes. If there isn't such an edge one is created.

####
      func (*Node) [AddToEdgeDiv](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.9:src/internal/profile/graph.go;l=93) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Node.AddToEdgeDiv)

      added in
      go1.23.0

  AddToEdgeDiv increases the weight of an edge between two nodes. If there isn't such an edge one is created.

NodeInfo contains the attributes for a node.

NodeMap maps from a node info struct to a node. It is used to merge report entries with the same info.

####
      func (NodeMap) [FindOrInsertNode](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.9:src/internal/profile/graph.go;l=166) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#NodeMap.FindOrInsertNode)

      added in
      go1.23.0

  FindOrInsertNode takes the info for a node and either returns a matching node from the node map if one exists, or adds one to the map if one does not. If kept is non-nil, nodes are only added if they can be located on it.

####
      type [NodePtrSet](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.9:src/internal/profile/graph.go;l=161) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#NodePtrSet)

      added in
      go1.23.0

  NodePtrSet is a collection of nodes. Trimming a graph or tree requires a set of objects which uniquely identify the nodes to keep. In a graph, NodeInfo works as a unique identifier; however, in a tree multiple nodes may share identical NodeInfos. A *Node does uniquely identify a node so we can use that instead. Though a *Node also uniquely identifies a node in a graph, currently, during trimming, graphs are rebuilt from scratch using only the NodeSet, so there would not be the required context of the initial graph to allow for the use of *Node.

Nodes is an ordered collection of graph nodes.

####
      func [CreateNodes](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.9:src/internal/profile/graph.go;l=370) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#CreateNodes)

      added in
      go1.23.0

  CreateNodes creates graph nodes for all locations in a profile. It returns set of all nodes, plus a mapping of each location to the set of corresponding nodes (one per location.Line).

type Profile struct {
	SampleType        []*
```
[ValueType](https://pkg.go.dev#ValueType)

	PeriodType    *[ValueType](https://pkg.go.dev#ValueType)
	Period        [int64](https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#int64)
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}
    Profile is an in-memory representation of profile.proto.

Merge merges all the profiles in profs into a single Profile. Returns a new profile independent of the input profiles. The merged profile is compacted to eliminate unused samples, locations, functions and mappings. Profiles must have identical profile sample and period types or the merge will fail. profile.Period of the resulting profile will be the maximum of all profiles, and profile.TimeNanos will be the earliest nonzero one.

Parse parses a profile and checks for its validity. The input must be an encoded pprof protobuf, which may optionally be gzip-compressed.

Aggregate merges the locations in the profile into equivalence classes preserving the request attributes. It also updates the samples to point to the merged locations.

####
      func (*Profile) [CheckValid](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.9:src/internal/profile/profile.go;l=187) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.CheckValid)

  CheckValid tests whether the profile is valid. Checks include, but are not limited to:

- len(Profile.Sample[n].value) == len(Profile.value_unit)
- Sample.id has a corresponding Profile.Location

####
      func (*Profile) [Compatible](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.9:src/internal/profile/profile.go;l=437) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.Compatible)

  Compatible determines if two profiles can be compared/merged. returns nil if the profiles are compatible; otherwise an error with details on the incompatibility.

Demangle attempts to demangle and optionally simplify any function names referenced in the profile. It works on a best-effort basis: it will silently preserve the original names in case of any errors.

####
      func (*Profile) [FilterSamplesByTag](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.9:src/internal/profile/filter.go;l=15) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.FilterSamplesByTag)

  FilterSamplesByTag removes all samples from the profile, except those that match focus and do not match the ignore regular expression.

####
      func (*Profile) [HasFileLines](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.9:src/internal/profile/profile.go;l=468) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.HasFileLines)

  HasFileLines determines if all locations in this profile have symbolized file and line number information.

####
      func (*Profile) [HasFunctions](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.9:src/internal/profile/profile.go;l=457) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.HasFunctions)

  HasFunctions determines if all locations in this profile have symbolized function information.

Merge adds profile p adjusted by ratio r into profile p. Profiles must be compatible (same Type and SampleType). TODO(rsilvera): consider normalizing the profiles based on the total samples collected.

Normalize normalizes the source profile by multiplying each value in profile by the ratio of the sum of the base profile's values of that sample type to the sum of the source profile's value of that sample type.

Prune removes all nodes beneath a node matching dropRx, and not matching keepRx. If the root node of a Sample matches, the sample will have an empty stack.

####
      func (*Profile) [RemoveUninteresting](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.9:src/internal/profile/prune.go;l=81) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.RemoveUninteresting)

  RemoveUninteresting prunes and elides profiles using built-in tables of uninteresting function names.

# profile package - internal/profile - Go Packages

Source: https://pkg.go.dev/internal/profile@go1.23.8

### Overview [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#pkg-overview)

Package profile represents a pprof profile as a directed graph.

This package is a simplified fork of github.com/google/pprof/internal/graph.

Package profile provides a representation of github.com/google/pprof/proto/profile.proto and methods to encode/decode/merge profiles in this format.

      func (*Profile) [FilterSamplesByTag](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.8:src/internal/profile/filter.go;l=15) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.FilterSamplesByTag)

  FilterSamplesByTag removes all samples from the profile, except those that match focus and do not match the ignore regular expression.

####
      func (*Profile) [HasFileLines](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.8:src/internal/profile/profile.go;l=468) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.HasFileLines)

  HasFileLines determines if all locations in this profile have symbolized file and line number information.

####
      func (*Profile) [HasFunctions](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.8:src/internal/profile/profile.go;l=457) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.HasFunctions)

  HasFunctions determines if all locations in this profile have symbolized function information.

Merge adds profile p adjusted by ratio r into profile p. Profiles must be compatible (same Type and SampleType). TODO(rsilvera): consider normalizing the profiles based on the total samples collected.

Normalize normalizes the source profile by multiplying each value in profile by the ratio of the sum of the base profile's values of that sample type to the sum of the source profile's value of that sample type.

Prune removes all nodes beneath a node matching dropRx, and not matching keepRx. If the root node of a Sample matches, the sample will have an empty stack.

####
      func (*Profile) [RemoveUninteresting](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.8:src/internal/profile/prune.go;l=81) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.RemoveUninteresting)

  RemoveUninteresting prunes and elides profiles using built-in tables of uninteresting function names.

	Location []*
```
[Location](https://pkg.go.dev#Location)
	Value    [][int64](https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#int64)
	Label    map[[string](https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#string)][][string](https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#string)

	// Function represents the function that this node belongs to. On

AddToEdge increases the weight of an edge between two nodes. If there isn't such an edge one is created.

####
      func (*Node) [AddToEdgeDiv](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.7:src/internal/profile/graph.go;l=93) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Node.AddToEdgeDiv)

      added in
      go1.23.0

  AddToEdgeDiv increases the weight of an edge between two nodes. If there isn't such an edge one is created.

NodeInfo contains the attributes for a node.

NodeMap maps from a node info struct to a node. It is used to merge report entries with the same info.

####
      func (NodeMap) [FindOrInsertNode](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.7:src/internal/profile/graph.go;l=166) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#NodeMap.FindOrInsertNode)

      added in
      go1.23.0

  FindOrInsertNode takes the info for a node and either returns a matching node from the node map if one exists, or adds one to the map if one does not. If kept is non-nil, nodes are only added if they can be located on it.

####
      type [NodePtrSet](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.7:src/internal/profile/graph.go;l=161) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#NodePtrSet)

      added in
      go1.23.0

  NodePtrSet is a collection of nodes. Trimming a graph or tree requires a set of objects which uniquely identify the nodes to keep. In a graph, NodeInfo works as a unique identifier; however, in a tree multiple nodes may share identical NodeInfos. A *Node does uniquely identify a node so we can use that instead. Though a *Node also uniquely identifies a node in a graph, currently, during trimming, graphs are rebuilt from scratch using only the NodeSet, so there would not be the required context of the initial graph to allow for the use of *Node.

Nodes is an ordered collection of graph nodes.

####
      func [CreateNodes](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.7:src/internal/profile/graph.go;l=370) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#CreateNodes)

      added in
      go1.23.0

  CreateNodes creates graph nodes for all locations in a profile. It returns set of all nodes, plus a mapping of each location to the set of corresponding nodes (one per location.Line).

    Profile is an in-memory representation of profile.proto.

Merge merges all the profiles in profs into a single Profile. Returns a new profile independent of the input profiles. The merged profile is compacted to eliminate unused samples, locations, functions and mappings. Profiles must have identical profile sample and period types or the merge will fail. profile.Period of the resulting profile will be the maximum of all profiles, and profile.TimeNanos will be the earliest nonzero one.

Parse parses a profile and checks for its validity. The input must be an encoded pprof protobuf, which may optionally be gzip-compressed.

Aggregate merges the locations in the profile into equivalence classes preserving the request attributes. It also updates the samples to point to the merged locations.

####
      func (*Profile) [CheckValid](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.7:src/internal/profile/profile.go;l=187) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.CheckValid)

  CheckValid tests whether the profile is valid. Checks include, but are not limited to:

- len(Profile.Sample[n].value) == len(Profile.value_unit)
- Sample.id has a corresponding Profile.Location

  NodePtrSet is a collection of nodes. Trimming a graph or tree requires a set of objects which uniquely identify the nodes to keep. In a graph, NodeInfo works as a unique identifier; however, in a tree multiple nodes may share identical NodeInfos. A *Node does uniquely identify a node so we can use that instead. Though a *Node also uniquely identifies a node in a graph, currently, during trimming, graphs are rebuilt from scratch using only the NodeSet, so there would not be the required context of the initial graph to allow for the use of *Node.

Nodes is an ordered collection of graph nodes.

####
      func [CreateNodes](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.6:src/internal/profile/graph.go;l=370) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#CreateNodes)

      added in
      go1.23.0

  CreateNodes creates graph nodes for all locations in a profile. It returns set of all nodes, plus a mapping of each location to the set of corresponding nodes (one per location.Line).

	SampleValue       func(s []

    Profile is an in-memory representation of profile.proto.

Merge merges all the profiles in profs into a single Profile. Returns a new profile independent of the input profiles. The merged profile is compacted to eliminate unused samples, locations, functions and mappings. Profiles must have identical profile sample and period types or the merge will fail. profile.Period of the resulting profile will be the maximum of all profiles, and profile.TimeNanos will be the earliest nonzero one.

Parse parses a profile and checks for its validity. The input must be an encoded pprof protobuf, which may optionally be gzip-compressed.

Aggregate merges the locations in the profile into equivalence classes preserving the request attributes. It also updates the samples to point to the merged locations.

####
      func (*Profile) [CheckValid](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.6:src/internal/profile/profile.go;l=187) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.CheckValid)

  CheckValid tests whether the profile is valid. Checks include, but are not limited to:

- len(Profile.Sample[n].value) == len(Profile.value_unit)
- Sample.id has a corresponding Profile.Location

####
      func (*Profile) [Compatible](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.6:src/internal/profile/profile.go;l=437) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.Compatible)

  Compatible determines if two profiles can be compared/merged. returns nil if the profiles are compatible; otherwise an error with details on the incompatibility.

Demangle attempts to demangle and optionally simplify any function names referenced in the profile. It works on a best-effort basis: it will silently preserve the original names in case of any errors.

####
      func (*Profile) [FilterSamplesByTag](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.6:src/internal/profile/filter.go;l=15) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.FilterSamplesByTag)

  FilterSamplesByTag removes all samples from the profile, except those that match focus and do not match the ignore regular expression.

####
      func (*Profile) [HasFileLines](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.6:src/internal/profile/profile.go;l=468) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.HasFileLines)

  HasFileLines determines if all locations in this profile have symbolized file and line number information.

####
      func (*Profile) [HasFunctions](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.6:src/internal/profile/profile.go;l=457) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.HasFunctions)

  HasFunctions determines if all locations in this profile have symbolized function information.

Merge adds profile p adjusted by ratio r into profile p. Profiles must be compatible (same Type and SampleType). TODO(rsilvera): consider normalizing the profiles based on the total samples collected.

Normalize normalizes the source profile by multiplying each value in profile by the ratio of the sum of the base profile's values of that sample type to the sum of the source profile's value of that sample type.

Prune removes all nodes beneath a node matching dropRx, and not matching keepRx. If the root node of a Sample matches, the sample will have an empty stack.

####
      func (*Profile) [RemoveUninteresting](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.6:src/internal/profile/prune.go;l=81) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.RemoveUninteresting)

# profile package - internal/profile - Go Packages

Source: https://pkg.go.dev/internal/profile@go1.23.5

### Overview [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#pkg-overview)

Package profile represents a pprof profile as a directed graph.

This package is a simplified fork of github.com/google/pprof/internal/graph.

Package profile provides a representation of github.com/google/pprof/proto/profile.proto and methods to encode/decode/merge profiles in this format.

[NodeInfo](https://pkg.go.dev#NodeInfo)
	// Function represents the function that this node belongs to. On
	// graphs with sub-function resolution (eg line number or
	// addresses), two nodes in a NodeMap that are part of the same
	// function have the same value of Node.Function. If the Node

	Function *[Node](https://pkg.go.dev#Node)

	// Cum includes all descendents.

	// this node.
	In, Out [EdgeMap](https://pkg.go.dev#EdgeMap)

    Node is an entry on a profiling report. It represents a unique program location.

AddToEdge increases the weight of an edge between two nodes. If there isn't such an edge one is created.

####
      func (*Node) [AddToEdgeDiv](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.4:src/internal/profile/graph.go;l=93) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Node.AddToEdgeDiv)

      added in
      go1.23.0

  AddToEdgeDiv increases the weight of an edge between two nodes. If there isn't such an edge one is created.

NodeInfo contains the attributes for a node.

NodeMap maps from a node info struct to a node. It is used to merge report entries with the same info.

####
      func (NodeMap) [FindOrInsertNode](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.4:src/internal/profile/graph.go;l=166) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#NodeMap.FindOrInsertNode)

      added in
      go1.23.0

  FindOrInsertNode takes the info for a node and either returns a matching node from the node map if one exists, or adds one to the map if one does not. If kept is non-nil, nodes are only added if they can be located on it.

####
      type [NodePtrSet](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.4:src/internal/profile/graph.go;l=161) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#NodePtrSet)

      added in
      go1.23.0

  NodePtrSet is a collection of nodes. Trimming a graph or tree requires a set of objects which uniquely identify the nodes to keep. In a graph, NodeInfo works as a unique identifier; however, in a tree multiple nodes may share identical NodeInfos. A *Node does uniquely identify a node so we can use that instead. Though a *Node also uniquely identifies a node in a graph, currently, during trimming, graphs are rebuilt from scratch using only the NodeSet, so there would not be the required context of the initial graph to allow for the use of *Node.

Nodes is an ordered collection of graph nodes.

####
      func [CreateNodes](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.4:src/internal/profile/graph.go;l=370) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#CreateNodes)

      added in
      go1.23.0

  CreateNodes creates graph nodes for all locations in a profile. It returns set of all nodes, plus a mapping of each location to the set of corresponding nodes (one per location.Line).

    Profile is an in-memory representation of profile.proto.

Merge merges all the profiles in profs into a single Profile. Returns a new profile independent of the input profiles. The merged profile is compacted to eliminate unused samples, locations, functions and mappings. Profiles must have identical profile sample and period types or the merge will fail. profile.Period of the resulting profile will be the maximum of all profiles, and profile.TimeNanos will be the earliest nonzero one.

Parse parses a profile and checks for its validity. The input must be an encoded pprof protobuf, which may optionally be gzip-compressed.

Aggregate merges the locations in the profile into equivalence classes preserving the request attributes. It also updates the samples to point to the merged locations.

####
      func (*Profile) [CheckValid](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.4:src/internal/profile/profile.go;l=187) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.CheckValid)

  CheckValid tests whether the profile is valid. Checks include, but are not limited to:

- len(Profile.Sample[n].value) == len(Profile.value_unit)
- Sample.id has a corresponding Profile.Location

####
      func (*Profile) [Compatible](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.4:src/internal/profile/profile.go;l=437) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.Compatible)

  Compatible determines if two profiles can be compared/merged. returns nil if the profiles are compatible; otherwise an error with details on the incompatibility.

Demangle attempts to demangle and optionally simplify any function names referenced in the profile. It works on a best-effort basis: it will silently preserve the original names in case of any errors.

####
      func (*Profile) [FilterSamplesByTag](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.4:src/internal/profile/filter.go;l=15) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.FilterSamplesByTag)

  FilterSamplesByTag removes all samples from the profile, except those that match focus and do not match the ignore regular expression.

####
      func (*Profile) [HasFileLines](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.4:src/internal/profile/profile.go;l=468) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.HasFileLines)

  HasFileLines determines if all locations in this profile have symbolized file and line number information.

####
      func (*Profile) [HasFunctions](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.4:src/internal/profile/profile.go;l=457) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.HasFunctions)

  HasFunctions determines if all locations in this profile have symbolized function information.

Merge adds profile p adjusted by ratio r into profile p. Profiles must be compatible (same Type and SampleType). TODO(rsilvera): consider normalizing the profiles based on the total samples collected.

Normalize normalizes the source profile by multiplying each value in profile by the ratio of the sum of the base profile's values of that sample type to the sum of the source profile's value of that sample type.

Prune removes all nodes beneath a node matching dropRx, and not matching keepRx. If the root node of a Sample matches, the sample will have an empty stack.

####
      func (*Profile) [RemoveUninteresting](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.4:src/internal/profile/prune.go;l=81) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.RemoveUninteresting)

  RemoveUninteresting prunes and elides profiles using built-in tables of uninteresting function names.

# profile package - internal/profile - Go Packages

Source: https://pkg.go.dev/internal/profile@go1.23.3

### Overview [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#pkg-overview)

Package profile represents a pprof profile as a directed graph.

This package is a simplified fork of github.com/google/pprof/internal/graph.

Package profile provides a representation of github.com/google/pprof/proto/profile.proto and methods to encode/decode/merge profiles in this format.

	// Info describes the source location associated to this node.
	Info

[NodeInfo](https://pkg.go.dev#NodeInfo)
	// Function represents the function that this node belongs to. On
	// graphs with sub-function resolution (eg line number or
	// addresses), two nodes in a NodeMap that are part of the same
	// function have the same value of Node.Function. If the Node
	// represents the whole function, it points back to itself.
	Function *[Node](https://pkg.go.dev#Node)
	// Values associated to this node. Flat is exclusive to this node,
	// Cum includes all descendents.
	Flat, FlatDiv, Cum, CumDiv [int64](https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#int64)
	// In and out Contains the nodes immediately reaching or reached by
	// this node.
	In, Out [EdgeMap](https://pkg.go.dev#EdgeMap)
}
    Node is an entry on a profiling report. It represents a unique program location.

AddToEdge increases the weight of an edge between two nodes. If there isn't such an edge one is created.

####
      func (*Node) [AddToEdgeDiv](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.2:src/internal/profile/graph.go;l=93) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Node.AddToEdgeDiv)

      added in
      go1.23.0

  AddToEdgeDiv increases the weight of an edge between two nodes. If there isn't such an edge one is created.

NodeInfo contains the attributes for a node.

NodeMap maps from a node info struct to a node. It is used to merge report entries with the same info.

####
      func (NodeMap) [FindOrInsertNode](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.2:src/internal/profile/graph.go;l=166) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#NodeMap.FindOrInsertNode)

      added in
      go1.23.0

  FindOrInsertNode takes the info for a node and either returns a matching node from the node map if one exists, or adds one to the map if one does not. If kept is non-nil, nodes are only added if they can be located on it.

####
      type [NodePtrSet](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.2:src/internal/profile/graph.go;l=161) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#NodePtrSet)

      added in
      go1.23.0

  NodePtrSet is a collection of nodes. Trimming a graph or tree requires a set of objects which uniquely identify the nodes to keep. In a graph, NodeInfo works as a unique identifier; however, in a tree multiple nodes may share identical NodeInfos. A *Node does uniquely identify a node so we can use that instead. Though a *Node also uniquely identifies a node in a graph, currently, during trimming, graphs are rebuilt from scratch using only the NodeSet, so there would not be the required context of the initial graph to allow for the use of *Node.

Nodes is an ordered collection of graph nodes.

####
      func [CreateNodes](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.2:src/internal/profile/graph.go;l=370) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#CreateNodes)

      added in
      go1.23.0

  CreateNodes creates graph nodes for all locations in a profile. It returns set of all nodes, plus a mapping of each location to the set of corresponding nodes (one per location.Line).

type Profile struct {
	SampleType        []*
```
[ValueType](https://pkg.go.dev#ValueType)
	DefaultSampleType [string](https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#string)

	Location          []*[Location](https://pkg.go.dev#Location)
	Function          []*[Function](https://pkg.go.dev#Function)

	KeepFrames [string](https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#string)
	TimeNanos     [int64](https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#int64)
	DurationNanos [int64](https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#int64)
	PeriodType    *[ValueType](https://pkg.go.dev#ValueType)
	Period        [int64](https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#int64)
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}
    Profile is an in-memory representation of profile.proto.

Merge merges all the profiles in profs into a single Profile. Returns a new profile independent of the input profiles. The merged profile is compacted to eliminate unused samples, locations, functions and mappings. Profiles must have identical profile sample and period types or the merge will fail. profile.Period of the resulting profile will be the maximum of all profiles, and profile.TimeNanos will be the earliest nonzero one.

Parse parses a profile and checks for its validity. The input must be an encoded pprof protobuf, which may optionally be gzip-compressed.

Aggregate merges the locations in the profile into equivalence classes preserving the request attributes. It also updates the samples to point to the merged locations.

####
      func (*Profile) [CheckValid](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.2:src/internal/profile/profile.go;l=187) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.CheckValid)

  CheckValid tests whether the profile is valid. Checks include, but are not limited to:

- len(Profile.Sample[n].value) == len(Profile.value_unit)
- Sample.id has a corresponding Profile.Location

####
      func (*Profile) [Compatible](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.2:src/internal/profile/profile.go;l=437) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.Compatible)

  Compatible determines if two profiles can be compared/merged. returns nil if the profiles are compatible; otherwise an error with details on the incompatibility.

Demangle attempts to demangle and optionally simplify any function names referenced in the profile. It works on a best-effort basis: it will silently preserve the original names in case of any errors.

####
      func (*Profile) [FilterSamplesByTag](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.2:src/internal/profile/filter.go;l=15) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.FilterSamplesByTag)

  FilterSamplesByTag removes all samples from the profile, except those that match focus and do not match the ignore regular expression.

####
      func (*Profile) [HasFileLines](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.2:src/internal/profile/profile.go;l=468) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.HasFileLines)

  HasFileLines determines if all locations in this profile have symbolized file and line number information.

####
      func (*Profile) [HasFunctions](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.2:src/internal/profile/profile.go;l=457) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.HasFunctions)

  HasFunctions determines if all locations in this profile have symbolized function information.

Merge adds profile p adjusted by ratio r into profile p. Profiles must be compatible (same Type and SampleType). TODO(rsilvera): consider normalizing the profiles based on the total samples collected.

Normalize normalizes the source profile by multiplying each value in profile by the ratio of the sum of the base profile's values of that sample type to the sum of the source profile's value of that sample type.

Prune removes all nodes beneath a node matching dropRx, and not matching keepRx. If the root node of a Sample matches, the sample will have an empty stack.

####
      func (*Profile) [RemoveUninteresting](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.2:src/internal/profile/prune.go;l=81) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.RemoveUninteresting)

  RemoveUninteresting prunes and elides profiles using built-in tables of uninteresting function names.

# profile package - internal/profile - Go Packages

Source: https://pkg.go.dev/internal/profile@go1.23.1

### Overview [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#pkg-overview)

Package profile represents a pprof profile as a directed graph.

This package is a simplified fork of github.com/google/pprof/internal/graph.

Package profile provides a representation of github.com/google/pprof/proto/profile.proto and methods to encode/decode/merge profiles in this format.

  Compatible determines if two profiles can be compared/merged. returns nil if the profiles are compatible; otherwise an error with details on the incompatibility.

Demangle attempts to demangle and optionally simplify any function names referenced in the profile. It works on a best-effort basis: it will silently preserve the original names in case of any errors.

####
      func (*Profile) [FilterSamplesByTag](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.1:src/internal/profile/filter.go;l=15) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.FilterSamplesByTag)

  FilterSamplesByTag removes all samples from the profile, except those that match focus and do not match the ignore regular expression.

####
      func (*Profile) [HasFileLines](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.1:src/internal/profile/profile.go;l=468) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.HasFileLines)

  HasFileLines determines if all locations in this profile have symbolized file and line number information.

####
      func (*Profile) [HasFunctions](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.1:src/internal/profile/profile.go;l=457) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.HasFunctions)

  HasFunctions determines if all locations in this profile have symbolized function information.

Merge adds profile p adjusted by ratio r into profile p. Profiles must be compatible (same Type and SampleType). TODO(rsilvera): consider normalizing the profiles based on the total samples collected.

Normalize normalizes the source profile by multiplying each value in profile by the ratio of the sum of the base profile's values of that sample type to the sum of the source profile's value of that sample type.

Prune removes all nodes beneath a node matching dropRx, and not matching keepRx. If the root node of a Sample matches, the sample will have an empty stack.

####
      func (*Profile) [RemoveUninteresting](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.1:src/internal/profile/prune.go;l=81) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.RemoveUninteresting)

  RemoveUninteresting prunes and elides profiles using built-in tables of uninteresting function names.

	Location []*
```
[Location](https://pkg.go.dev#Location)
	Value    [][int64](https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#int64)
	Label    map[[string](https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#string)][][string](https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#string)

# profile package - internal/profile - Go Packages

Source: https://pkg.go.dev/internal/profile@go1.23.0

### Overview [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#pkg-overview)

Package profile represents a pprof profile as a directed graph.

This package is a simplified fork of github.com/google/pprof/internal/graph.

Package profile provides a representation of github.com/google/pprof/proto/profile.proto and methods to encode/decode/merge profiles in this format.

[NodeInfo](https://pkg.go.dev#NodeInfo)
	// Function represents the function that this node belongs to. On
	// graphs with sub-function resolution (eg line number or
	// addresses), two nodes in a NodeMap that are part of the same
	// function have the same value of Node.Function. If the Node

	// this node.
	In, Out [EdgeMap](https://pkg.go.dev#EdgeMap)
}
    Node is an entry on a profiling report. It represents a unique program location.

AddToEdge increases the weight of an edge between two nodes. If there isn't such an edge one is created.

####
      func (*Node) [AddToEdgeDiv](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.0:src/internal/profile/graph.go;l=93) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Node.AddToEdgeDiv)

      added in
      go1.23.0

  AddToEdgeDiv increases the weight of an edge between two nodes. If there isn't such an edge one is created.

NodeInfo contains the attributes for a node.

NodeMap maps from a node info struct to a node. It is used to merge report entries with the same info.

####
      func (NodeMap) [FindOrInsertNode](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.0:src/internal/profile/graph.go;l=166) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#NodeMap.FindOrInsertNode)

      added in
      go1.23.0

  FindOrInsertNode takes the info for a node and either returns a matching node from the node map if one exists, or adds one to the map if one does not. If kept is non-nil, nodes are only added if they can be located on it.

####
      type [NodePtrSet](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.0:src/internal/profile/graph.go;l=161) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#NodePtrSet)

      added in
      go1.23.0

  NodePtrSet is a collection of nodes. Trimming a graph or tree requires a set of objects which uniquely identify the nodes to keep. In a graph, NodeInfo works as a unique identifier; however, in a tree multiple nodes may share identical NodeInfos. A *Node does uniquely identify a node so we can use that instead. Though a *Node also uniquely identifies a node in a graph, currently, during trimming, graphs are rebuilt from scratch using only the NodeSet, so there would not be the required context of the initial graph to allow for the use of *Node.

Nodes is an ordered collection of graph nodes.

####
      func [CreateNodes](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.0:src/internal/profile/graph.go;l=370) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#CreateNodes)

      added in
      go1.23.0

  CreateNodes creates graph nodes for all locations in a profile. It returns set of all nodes, plus a mapping of each location to the set of corresponding nodes (one per location.Line).

	Period        [int64](https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#int64)
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}
    Profile is an in-memory representation of profile.proto.

Merge merges all the profiles in profs into a single Profile. Returns a new profile independent of the input profiles. The merged profile is compacted to eliminate unused samples, locations, functions and mappings. Profiles must have identical profile sample and period types or the merge will fail. profile.Period of the resulting profile will be the maximum of all profiles, and profile.TimeNanos will be the earliest nonzero one.

Parse parses a profile and checks for its validity. The input must be an encoded pprof protobuf, which may optionally be gzip-compressed.

Aggregate merges the locations in the profile into equivalence classes preserving the request attributes. It also updates the samples to point to the merged locations.

####
      func (*Profile) [CheckValid](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23.0:src/internal/profile/profile.go;l=187) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.CheckValid)

  CheckValid tests whether the profile is valid. Checks include, but are not limited to:

- len(Profile.Sample[n].value) == len(Profile.value_unit)
- Sample.id has a corresponding Profile.Location

  FindOrInsertNode takes the info for a node and either returns a matching node from the node map if one exists, or adds one to the map if one does not. If kept is non-nil, nodes are only added if they can be located on it.

####
      type [NodePtrSet](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23rc2:src/internal/profile/graph.go;l=161) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#NodePtrSet)

      added in
      go1.23.0

  NodePtrSet is a collection of nodes. Trimming a graph or tree requires a set of objects which uniquely identify the nodes to keep. In a graph, NodeInfo works as a unique identifier; however, in a tree multiple nodes may share identical NodeInfos. A *Node does uniquely identify a node so we can use that instead. Though a *Node also uniquely identifies a node in a graph, currently, during trimming, graphs are rebuilt from scratch using only the NodeSet, so there would not be the required context of the initial graph to allow for the use of *Node.

Nodes is an ordered collection of graph nodes.

####
      func [CreateNodes](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23rc2:src/internal/profile/graph.go;l=370) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#CreateNodes)

      added in
      go1.23.0

  CreateNodes creates graph nodes for all locations in a profile. It returns set of all nodes, plus a mapping of each location to the set of corresponding nodes (one per location.Line).

Merge merges all the profiles in profs into a single Profile. Returns a new profile independent of the input profiles. The merged profile is compacted to eliminate unused samples, locations, functions and mappings. Profiles must have identical profile sample and period types or the merge will fail. profile.Period of the resulting profile will be the maximum of all profiles, and profile.TimeNanos will be the earliest nonzero one.

Parse parses a profile and checks for its validity. The input must be an encoded pprof protobuf, which may optionally be gzip-compressed.

Aggregate merges the locations in the profile into equivalence classes preserving the request attributes. It also updates the samples to point to the merged locations.

####
      func (*Profile) [CheckValid](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23rc2:src/internal/profile/profile.go;l=187) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.CheckValid)

  CheckValid tests whether the profile is valid. Checks include, but are not limited to:

- len(Profile.Sample[n].value) == len(Profile.value_unit)
- Sample.id has a corresponding Profile.Location

      func (*Profile) [Compatible](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23rc2:src/internal/profile/profile.go;l=437) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.Compatible)

  Compatible determines if two profiles can be compared/merged. returns nil if the profiles are compatible; otherwise an error with details on the incompatibility.

Demangle attempts to demangle and optionally simplify any function names referenced in the profile. It works on a best-effort basis: it will silently preserve the original names in case of any errors.

####
      func (*Profile) [FilterSamplesByTag](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23rc2:src/internal/profile/filter.go;l=15) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.FilterSamplesByTag)

####
      func (*Profile) [HasFunctions](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.23rc2:src/internal/profile/profile.go;l=457) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.HasFunctions)

  HasFunctions determines if all locations in this profile have symbolized function information.

Merge adds profile p adjusted by ratio r into profile p. Profiles must be compatible (same Type and SampleType). TODO(rsilvera): consider normalizing the profiles based on the total samples collected.

Normalize normalizes the source profile by multiplying each value in profile by the ratio of the sum of the base profile's values of that sample type to the sum of the source profile's value of that sample type.

Prune removes all nodes beneath a node matching dropRx, and not matching keepRx. If the root node of a Sample matches, the sample will have an empty stack.

# profile package - internal/profile - Go Packages

Source: https://pkg.go.dev/internal/profile@go1.23rc1

### Overview [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#pkg-overview)

Package profile represents a pprof profile as a directed graph.

This package is a simplified fork of github.com/google/pprof/internal/graph.

Package profile provides a representation of github.com/google/pprof/proto/profile.proto and methods to encode/decode/merge profiles in this format.

    Profile is an in-memory representation of profile.proto.

Merge merges all the profiles in profs into a single Profile. Returns a new profile independent of the input profiles. The merged profile is compacted to eliminate unused samples, locations, functions and mappings. Profiles must have identical profile sample and period types or the merge will fail. profile.Period of the resulting profile will be the maximum of all profiles, and profile.TimeNanos will be the earliest nonzero one.

Parse parses a profile and checks for its validity. The input may be a gzip-compressed encoded protobuf or one of many legacy profile formats which may be unsupported in the future.

####
      func [ParseTracebacks](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.12:src/internal/profile/legacy_profile.go;l=252) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#ParseTracebacks)

  ParseTracebacks parses a set of tracebacks and returns a newly populated profile. It will accept any text file and generate a Profile out of it with any hex addresses it can identify, including a process map if it can recognize one. Each sample will include a tag "source" with the addresses recognized in string format.

Aggregate merges the locations in the profile into equivalence classes preserving the request attributes. It also updates the samples to point to the merged locations.

####
      func (*Profile) [CheckValid](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.12:src/internal/profile/profile.go;l=241) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.CheckValid)

  CheckValid tests whether the profile is valid. Checks include, but are not limited to:

- len(Profile.Sample[n].value) == len(Profile.value_unit)
- Sample.id has a corresponding Profile.Location

####
      func (*Profile) [Compatible](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.12:src/internal/profile/profile.go;l=491) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.Compatible)

  Compatible determines if two profiles can be compared/merged. returns nil if the profiles are compatible; otherwise an error with details on the incompatibility.

Demangle attempts to demangle and optionally simplify any function names referenced in the profile. It works on a best-effort basis: it will silently preserve the original names in case of any errors.

####
      func (*Profile) [FilterSamplesByName](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.12:src/internal/profile/filter.go;l=14) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.FilterSamplesByName)

  FilterSamplesByName filters the samples in a profile and only keeps samples where at least one frame matches focus but none match ignore. Returns true is the corresponding regexp matched at least one sample.

####
      func (*Profile) [FilterSamplesByTag](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.12:src/internal/profile/filter.go;l=119) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.FilterSamplesByTag)

  FilterSamplesByTag removes all samples from the profile, except those that match focus and do not match the ignore regular expression.

####
      func (*Profile) [HasFileLines](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.12:src/internal/profile/profile.go;l=522) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.HasFileLines)

  HasFileLines determines if all locations in this profile have symbolized file and line number information.

####
      func (*Profile) [HasFunctions](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.12:src/internal/profile/profile.go;l=511) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.HasFunctions)

  HasFunctions determines if all locations in this profile have symbolized function information.

Merge adds profile p adjusted by ratio r into profile p. Profiles must be compatible (same Type and SampleType). TODO(rsilvera): consider normalizing the profiles based on the total samples collected.

Normalize normalizes the source profile by multiplying each value in profile by the ratio of the sum of the base profile's values of that sample type to the sum of the source profile's value of that sample type.

####
      func (*Profile) [ParseMemoryMap](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.12:src/internal/profile/legacy_profile.go;l=1024) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.ParseMemoryMap)

  ParseMemoryMap parses a memory map in the format of /proc/self/maps, and overrides the mappings in the current profile. It renumbers the samples and locations in the profile correspondingly.

Prune removes all nodes beneath a node matching dropRx, and not matching keepRx. If the root node of a Sample matches, the sample will have an empty stack.

####
      func (*Profile) [RemoveUninteresting](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.12:src/internal/profile/prune.go;l=81) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.RemoveUninteresting)

  RemoveUninteresting prunes and elides profiles using built-in tables of uninteresting function names.

```
type Sample struct {
	Location []*
```
[Location](https://pkg.go.dev#Location)
	Value    [][int64](https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#int64)
	Label    map[[string](https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#string)][][string](https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#string)
	NumLabel map[[string](https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#string)][][int64](https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#int64)
	NumUnit  map[[string](https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#string)][][string](https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#string)
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}

Parse parses a profile and checks for its validity. The input may be a gzip-compressed encoded protobuf or one of many legacy profile formats which may be unsupported in the future.

####
      func [ParseTracebacks](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.10:src/internal/profile/legacy_profile.go;l=252) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#ParseTracebacks)

  ParseTracebacks parses a set of tracebacks and returns a newly populated profile. It will accept any text file and generate a Profile out of it with any hex addresses it can identify, including a process map if it can recognize one. Each sample will include a tag "source" with the addresses recognized in string format.

Aggregate merges the locations in the profile into equivalence classes preserving the request attributes. It also updates the samples to point to the merged locations.

####
      func (*Profile) [CheckValid](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.10:src/internal/profile/profile.go;l=241) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.CheckValid)

  CheckValid tests whether the profile is valid. Checks include, but are not limited to:

- len(Profile.Sample[n].value) == len(Profile.value_unit)
- Sample.id has a corresponding Profile.Location

####
      func (*Profile) [Compatible](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.10:src/internal/profile/profile.go;l=491) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.Compatible)

  Compatible determines if two profiles can be compared/merged. returns nil if the profiles are compatible; otherwise an error with details on the incompatibility.

Demangle attempts to demangle and optionally simplify any function names referenced in the profile. It works on a best-effort basis: it will silently preserve the original names in case of any errors.

####
      func (*Profile) [FilterSamplesByName](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.10:src/internal/profile/filter.go;l=14) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.FilterSamplesByName)

  FilterSamplesByName filters the samples in a profile and only keeps samples where at least one frame matches focus but none match ignore. Returns true is the corresponding regexp matched at least one sample.

####
      func (*Profile) [FilterSamplesByTag](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.10:src/internal/profile/filter.go;l=119) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.FilterSamplesByTag)

  FilterSamplesByTag removes all samples from the profile, except those that match focus and do not match the ignore regular expression.

####
      func (*Profile) [HasFileLines](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.10:src/internal/profile/profile.go;l=522) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.HasFileLines)

  HasFileLines determines if all locations in this profile have symbolized file and line number information.

####
      func (*Profile) [HasFunctions](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.10:src/internal/profile/profile.go;l=511) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.HasFunctions)

  HasFunctions determines if all locations in this profile have symbolized function information.

Merge adds profile p adjusted by ratio r into profile p. Profiles must be compatible (same Type and SampleType). TODO(rsilvera): consider normalizing the profiles based on the total samples collected.

Normalize normalizes the source profile by multiplying each value in profile by the ratio of the sum of the base profile's values of that sample type to the sum of the source profile's value of that sample type.

####
      func (*Profile) [ParseMemoryMap](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.10:src/internal/profile/legacy_profile.go;l=1024) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.ParseMemoryMap)

  ParseMemoryMap parses a memory map in the format of /proc/self/maps, and overrides the mappings in the current profile. It renumbers the samples and locations in the profile correspondingly.

Prune removes all nodes beneath a node matching dropRx, and not matching keepRx. If the root node of a Sample matches, the sample will have an empty stack.

####
      func (*Profile) [RemoveUninteresting](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.10:src/internal/profile/prune.go;l=81) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.RemoveUninteresting)

  RemoveUninteresting prunes and elides profiles using built-in tables of uninteresting function names.

```
type Sample struct {
	Location []*
```
[Location](https://pkg.go.dev#Location)
	Value    [][int64](https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#int64)
	Label    map[[string](https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#string)][][string](https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#string)

      func (*Profile) [HasFunctions](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.8:src/internal/profile/profile.go;l=511) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.HasFunctions)

  HasFunctions determines if all locations in this profile have symbolized function information.

Merge adds profile p adjusted by ratio r into profile p. Profiles must be compatible (same Type and SampleType). TODO(rsilvera): consider normalizing the profiles based on the total samples collected.

Normalize normalizes the source profile by multiplying each value in profile by the ratio of the sum of the base profile's values of that sample type to the sum of the source profile's value of that sample type.

####
      func (*Profile) [ParseMemoryMap](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.8:src/internal/profile/legacy_profile.go;l=1024) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.ParseMemoryMap)

  ParseMemoryMap parses a memory map in the format of /proc/self/maps, and overrides the mappings in the current profile. It renumbers the samples and locations in the profile correspondingly.

Prune removes all nodes beneath a node matching dropRx, and not matching keepRx. If the root node of a Sample matches, the sample will have an empty stack.

####
      func (*Profile) [RemoveUninteresting](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.8:src/internal/profile/prune.go;l=81) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.RemoveUninteresting)

  RemoveUninteresting prunes and elides profiles using built-in tables of uninteresting function names.

	Location []*

    Profile is an in-memory representation of profile.proto.

Merge merges all the profiles in profs into a single Profile. Returns a new profile independent of the input profiles. The merged profile is compacted to eliminate unused samples, locations, functions and mappings. Profiles must have identical profile sample and period types or the merge will fail. profile.Period of the resulting profile will be the maximum of all profiles, and profile.TimeNanos will be the earliest nonzero one.

Parse parses a profile and checks for its validity. The input may be a gzip-compressed encoded protobuf or one of many legacy profile formats which may be unsupported in the future.

####
      func [ParseTracebacks](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.7:src/internal/profile/legacy_profile.go;l=252) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#ParseTracebacks)

  ParseTracebacks parses a set of tracebacks and returns a newly populated profile. It will accept any text file and generate a Profile out of it with any hex addresses it can identify, including a process map if it can recognize one. Each sample will include a tag "source" with the addresses recognized in string format.

Aggregate merges the locations in the profile into equivalence classes preserving the request attributes. It also updates the samples to point to the merged locations.

####
      func (*Profile) [CheckValid](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.7:src/internal/profile/profile.go;l=241) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.CheckValid)

  CheckValid tests whether the profile is valid. Checks include, but are not limited to:

- len(Profile.Sample[n].value) == len(Profile.value_unit)
- Sample.id has a corresponding Profile.Location

####
      func (*Profile) [Compatible](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.7:src/internal/profile/profile.go;l=491) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.Compatible)

  Compatible determines if two profiles can be compared/merged. returns nil if the profiles are compatible; otherwise an error with details on the incompatibility.

Demangle attempts to demangle and optionally simplify any function names referenced in the profile. It works on a best-effort basis: it will silently preserve the original names in case of any errors.

####
      func (*Profile) [FilterSamplesByName](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.7:src/internal/profile/filter.go;l=14) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.FilterSamplesByName)

  FilterSamplesByName filters the samples in a profile and only keeps samples where at least one frame matches focus but none match ignore. Returns true is the corresponding regexp matched at least one sample.

####
      func (*Profile) [FilterSamplesByTag](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.7:src/internal/profile/filter.go;l=119) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.FilterSamplesByTag)

  FilterSamplesByTag removes all samples from the profile, except those that match focus and do not match the ignore regular expression.

####

      func (*Profile) [HasFunctions](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.7:src/internal/profile/profile.go;l=511) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.HasFunctions)

  HasFunctions determines if all locations in this profile have symbolized function information.

Merge adds profile p adjusted by ratio r into profile p. Profiles must be compatible (same Type and SampleType). TODO(rsilvera): consider normalizing the profiles based on the total samples collected.

Normalize normalizes the source profile by multiplying each value in profile by the ratio of the sum of the base profile's values of that sample type to the sum of the source profile's value of that sample type.

####
      func (*Profile) [ParseMemoryMap](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.7:src/internal/profile/legacy_profile.go;l=1024) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.ParseMemoryMap)

    Profile is an in-memory representation of profile.proto.

Merge merges all the profiles in profs into a single Profile. Returns a new profile independent of the input profiles. The merged profile is compacted to eliminate unused samples, locations, functions and mappings. Profiles must have identical profile sample and period types or the merge will fail. profile.Period of the resulting profile will be the maximum of all profiles, and profile.TimeNanos will be the earliest nonzero one.

Parse parses a profile and checks for its validity. The input may be a gzip-compressed encoded protobuf or one of many legacy profile formats which may be unsupported in the future.

####
      func [ParseTracebacks](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.5:src/internal/profile/legacy_profile.go;l=252) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#ParseTracebacks)

  ParseTracebacks parses a set of tracebacks and returns a newly populated profile. It will accept any text file and generate a Profile out of it with any hex addresses it can identify, including a process map if it can recognize one. Each sample will include a tag "source" with the addresses recognized in string format.

Aggregate merges the locations in the profile into equivalence classes preserving the request attributes. It also updates the samples to point to the merged locations.

####
      func (*Profile) [CheckValid](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.5:src/internal/profile/profile.go;l=241) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.CheckValid)

  CheckValid tests whether the profile is valid. Checks include, but are not limited to:

- len(Profile.Sample[n].value) == len(Profile.value_unit)
- Sample.id has a corresponding Profile.Location

####
      func (*Profile) [Compatible](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.5:src/internal/profile/profile.go;l=491) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.Compatible)

  Compatible determines if two profiles can be compared/merged. returns nil if the profiles are compatible; otherwise an error with details on the incompatibility.

Demangle attempts to demangle and optionally simplify any function names referenced in the profile. It works on a best-effort basis: it will silently preserve the original names in case of any errors.

####
      func (*Profile) [FilterSamplesByName](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.5:src/internal/profile/filter.go;l=14) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.FilterSamplesByName)

  FilterSamplesByName filters the samples in a profile and only keeps samples where at least one frame matches focus but none match ignore. Returns true is the corresponding regexp matched at least one sample.

####
      func (*Profile) [FilterSamplesByTag](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.5:src/internal/profile/filter.go;l=119) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.FilterSamplesByTag)

  FilterSamplesByTag removes all samples from the profile, except those that match focus and do not match the ignore regular expression.

####
      func (*Profile) [HasFileLines](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.5:src/internal/profile/profile.go;l=522) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.HasFileLines)

  HasFileLines determines if all locations in this profile have symbolized file and line number information.

####
      func (*Profile) [HasFunctions](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.5:src/internal/profile/profile.go;l=511) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.HasFunctions)

  HasFunctions determines if all locations in this profile have symbolized function information.

Merge adds profile p adjusted by ratio r into profile p. Profiles must be compatible (same Type and SampleType). TODO(rsilvera): consider normalizing the profiles based on the total samples collected.

Normalize normalizes the source profile by multiplying each value in profile by the ratio of the sum of the base profile's values of that sample type to the sum of the source profile's value of that sample type.

####
      func (*Profile) [ParseMemoryMap](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.5:src/internal/profile/legacy_profile.go;l=1024) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.ParseMemoryMap)

  ParseMemoryMap parses a memory map in the format of /proc/self/maps, and overrides the mappings in the current profile. It renumbers the samples and locations in the profile correspondingly.

Prune removes all nodes beneath a node matching dropRx, and not matching keepRx. If the root node of a Sample matches, the sample will have an empty stack.

####
      func (*Profile) [RemoveUninteresting](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.5:src/internal/profile/prune.go;l=81) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.RemoveUninteresting)

  RemoveUninteresting prunes and elides profiles using built-in tables of uninteresting function names.

```
type Sample struct {
	Location []*
```
[Location](https://pkg.go.dev#Location)
	Value    [][int64](https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#int64)
	Label    map[[string](https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#string)][][string](https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#string)
	NumLabel map[[string](https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#string)][][int64](https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#int64)
	NumUnit  map[[string](https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#string)][][string](https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#string)
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}
    Sample corresponds to Profile.Sample

    Profile is an in-memory representation of profile.proto.

Merge merges all the profiles in profs into a single Profile. Returns a new profile independent of the input profiles. The merged profile is compacted to eliminate unused samples, locations, functions and mappings. Profiles must have identical profile sample and period types or the merge will fail. profile.Period of the resulting profile will be the maximum of all profiles, and profile.TimeNanos will be the earliest nonzero one.

Parse parses a profile and checks for its validity. The input may be a gzip-compressed encoded protobuf or one of many legacy profile formats which may be unsupported in the future.

####
      func [ParseTracebacks](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.3:src/internal/profile/legacy_profile.go;l=252) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#ParseTracebacks)

  ParseTracebacks parses a set of tracebacks and returns a newly populated profile. It will accept any text file and generate a Profile out of it with any hex addresses it can identify, including a process map if it can recognize one. Each sample will include a tag "source" with the addresses recognized in string format.

Aggregate merges the locations in the profile into equivalence classes preserving the request attributes. It also updates the samples to point to the merged locations.

####
      func (*Profile) [CheckValid](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.3:src/internal/profile/profile.go;l=241) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.CheckValid)

  CheckValid tests whether the profile is valid. Checks include, but are not limited to:

- len(Profile.Sample[n].value) == len(Profile.value_unit)
- Sample.id has a corresponding Profile.Location

####
      func (*Profile) [Compatible](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.3:src/internal/profile/profile.go;l=491) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.Compatible)

  Compatible determines if two profiles can be compared/merged. returns nil if the profiles are compatible; otherwise an error with details on the incompatibility.

Demangle attempts to demangle and optionally simplify any function names referenced in the profile. It works on a best-effort basis: it will silently preserve the original names in case of any errors.

####
      func (*Profile) [FilterSamplesByName](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.3:src/internal/profile/filter.go;l=14) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.FilterSamplesByName)

  FilterSamplesByName filters the samples in a profile and only keeps samples where at least one frame matches focus but none match ignore. Returns true is the corresponding regexp matched at least one sample.

####
      func (*Profile) [FilterSamplesByTag](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.3:src/internal/profile/filter.go;l=119) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.FilterSamplesByTag)

  FilterSamplesByTag removes all samples from the profile, except those that match focus and do not match the ignore regular expression.

####
      func (*Profile) [HasFileLines](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.3:src/internal/profile/profile.go;l=522) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.HasFileLines)

  HasFileLines determines if all locations in this profile have symbolized file and line number information.

####
      func (*Profile) [HasFunctions](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.3:src/internal/profile/profile.go;l=511) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.HasFunctions)

  HasFunctions determines if all locations in this profile have symbolized function information.

Merge adds profile p adjusted by ratio r into profile p. Profiles must be compatible (same Type and SampleType). TODO(rsilvera): consider normalizing the profiles based on the total samples collected.

Normalize normalizes the source profile by multiplying each value in profile by the ratio of the sum of the base profile's values of that sample type to the sum of the source profile's value of that sample type.

####
      func (*Profile) [ParseMemoryMap](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.3:src/internal/profile/legacy_profile.go;l=1024) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.ParseMemoryMap)

  ParseMemoryMap parses a memory map in the format of /proc/self/maps, and overrides the mappings in the current profile. It renumbers the samples and locations in the profile correspondingly.

Prune removes all nodes beneath a node matching dropRx, and not matching keepRx. If the root node of a Sample matches, the sample will have an empty stack.

####
      func (*Profile) [RemoveUninteresting](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.3:src/internal/profile/prune.go;l=81) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.RemoveUninteresting)

  RemoveUninteresting prunes and elides profiles using built-in tables of uninteresting function names.

```
type Sample struct {
	Location []*
```
[Location](https://pkg.go.dev#Location)
	Value    [][int64](https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#int64)
	Label    map[[string](https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#string)][][string](https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#string)
	NumLabel map[[string](https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#string)][][int64](https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#int64)
	NumUnit  map[[string](https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#string)][][string](https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#string)
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}
    Sample corresponds to Profile.Sample

	HasInlineFrames [bool](https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#bool)
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}
    Mapping corresponds to Profile.Mapping

```
type Profile struct {
	SampleType        []*
```
[ValueType](https://pkg.go.dev#ValueType)
	DefaultSampleType [string](https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#string)
	Sample            []*[Sample](https://pkg.go.dev#Sample)
	Mapping           []*[Mapping](https://pkg.go.dev#Mapping)
	Location          []*[Location](https://pkg.go.dev#Location)
	Function          []*[Function](https://pkg.go.dev#Function)
	Comments          [][string](https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#string)

	KeepFrames [string](https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#string)
	TimeNanos     [int64](https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#int64)
	DurationNanos [int64](https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#int64)
	PeriodType    *[ValueType](https://pkg.go.dev#ValueType)
	Period        [int64](https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#int64)
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}
    Profile is an in-memory representation of profile.proto.

Merge merges all the profiles in profs into a single Profile. Returns a new profile independent of the input profiles. The merged profile is compacted to eliminate unused samples, locations, functions and mappings. Profiles must have identical profile sample and period types or the merge will fail. profile.Period of the resulting profile will be the maximum of all profiles, and profile.TimeNanos will be the earliest nonzero one.

Parse parses a profile and checks for its validity. The input may be a gzip-compressed encoded protobuf or one of many legacy profile formats which may be unsupported in the future.

####
      func [ParseTracebacks](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.1:src/internal/profile/legacy_profile.go;l=252) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#ParseTracebacks)

  ParseTracebacks parses a set of tracebacks and returns a newly populated profile. It will accept any text file and generate a Profile out of it with any hex addresses it can identify, including a process map if it can recognize one. Each sample will include a tag "source" with the addresses recognized in string format.

Aggregate merges the locations in the profile into equivalence classes preserving the request attributes. It also updates the samples to point to the merged locations.

####
      func (*Profile) [CheckValid](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.1:src/internal/profile/profile.go;l=241) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.CheckValid)

  CheckValid tests whether the profile is valid. Checks include, but are not limited to:

- len(Profile.Sample[n].value) == len(Profile.value_unit)
- Sample.id has a corresponding Profile.Location

####
      func (*Profile) [Compatible](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.1:src/internal/profile/profile.go;l=491) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.Compatible)

  Compatible determines if two profiles can be compared/merged. returns nil if the profiles are compatible; otherwise an error with details on the incompatibility.

Demangle attempts to demangle and optionally simplify any function names referenced in the profile. It works on a best-effort basis: it will silently preserve the original names in case of any errors.

####
      func (*Profile) [FilterSamplesByName](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.1:src/internal/profile/filter.go;l=14) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.FilterSamplesByName)

  FilterSamplesByName filters the samples in a profile and only keeps samples where at least one frame matches focus but none match ignore. Returns true is the corresponding regexp matched at least one sample.

####
      func (*Profile) [FilterSamplesByTag](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.1:src/internal/profile/filter.go;l=119) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.FilterSamplesByTag)

  FilterSamplesByTag removes all samples from the profile, except those that match focus and do not match the ignore regular expression.

####
      func (*Profile) [HasFileLines](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.1:src/internal/profile/profile.go;l=522) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.HasFileLines)

  HasFileLines determines if all locations in this profile have symbolized file and line number information.

####
      func (*Profile) [HasFunctions](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.1:src/internal/profile/profile.go;l=511) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.HasFunctions)

  HasFunctions determines if all locations in this profile have symbolized function information.

Merge adds profile p adjusted by ratio r into profile p. Profiles must be compatible (same Type and SampleType). TODO(rsilvera): consider normalizing the profiles based on the total samples collected.

Normalize normalizes the source profile by multiplying each value in profile by the ratio of the sum of the base profile's values of that sample type to the sum of the source profile's value of that sample type.

####
      func (*Profile) [ParseMemoryMap](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.1:src/internal/profile/legacy_profile.go;l=1024) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.ParseMemoryMap)

  ParseMemoryMap parses a memory map in the format of /proc/self/maps, and overrides the mappings in the current profile. It renumbers the samples and locations in the profile correspondingly.

Prune removes all nodes beneath a node matching dropRx, and not matching keepRx. If the root node of a Sample matches, the sample will have an empty stack.

####
      func (*Profile) [RemoveUninteresting](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22.1:src/internal/profile/prune.go;l=81) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.RemoveUninteresting)

  RemoveUninteresting prunes and elides profiles using built-in tables of uninteresting function names.

```
type Sample struct {
	Location []*
```
[Location](https://pkg.go.dev#Location)
	Value    [][int64](https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#int64)
	Label    map[[string](https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#string)][][string](https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#string)
	NumLabel map[[string](https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#string)][][int64](https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#int64)
	NumUnit  map[[string](https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#string)][][string](https://pkg.go.dev/builtin#string)

      func (*Profile) [Compatible](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22rc2:src/internal/profile/profile.go;l=491) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.Compatible)

  Compatible determines if two profiles can be compared/merged. returns nil if the profiles are compatible; otherwise an error with details on the incompatibility.

Demangle attempts to demangle and optionally simplify any function names referenced in the profile. It works on a best-effort basis: it will silently preserve the original names in case of any errors.

####
      func (*Profile) [FilterSamplesByName](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22rc2:src/internal/profile/filter.go;l=14) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.FilterSamplesByName)

  FilterSamplesByName filters the samples in a profile and only keeps samples where at least one frame matches focus but none match ignore. Returns true is the corresponding regexp matched at least one sample.

####
      func (*Profile) [FilterSamplesByTag](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22rc2:src/internal/profile/filter.go;l=119) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.FilterSamplesByTag)

  FilterSamplesByTag removes all samples from the profile, except those that match focus and do not match the ignore regular expression.

####
      func (*Profile) [HasFileLines](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22rc2:src/internal/profile/profile.go;l=522) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.HasFileLines)

  HasFileLines determines if all locations in this profile have symbolized file and line number information.

####
      func (*Profile) [HasFunctions](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22rc2:src/internal/profile/profile.go;l=511) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.HasFunctions)

  HasFunctions determines if all locations in this profile have symbolized function information.

Merge adds profile p adjusted by ratio r into profile p. Profiles must be compatible (same Type and SampleType). TODO(rsilvera): consider normalizing the profiles based on the total samples collected.

Normalize normalizes the source profile by multiplying each value in profile by the ratio of the sum of the base profile's values of that sample type to the sum of the source profile's value of that sample type.

####
      func (*Profile) [ParseMemoryMap](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22rc2:src/internal/profile/legacy_profile.go;l=1024) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.ParseMemoryMap)

  ParseMemoryMap parses a memory map in the format of /proc/self/maps, and overrides the mappings in the current profile. It renumbers the samples and locations in the profile correspondingly.

Prune removes all nodes beneath a node matching dropRx, and not matching keepRx. If the root node of a Sample matches, the sample will have an empty stack.

####
      func (*Profile) [RemoveUninteresting](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22rc2:src/internal/profile/prune.go;l=81) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.RemoveUninteresting)

  RemoveUninteresting prunes and elides profiles using built-in tables of uninteresting function names.

	Location []*

    Profile is an in-memory representation of profile.proto.

Merge merges all the profiles in profs into a single Profile. Returns a new profile independent of the input profiles. The merged profile is compacted to eliminate unused samples, locations, functions and mappings. Profiles must have identical profile sample and period types or the merge will fail. profile.Period of the resulting profile will be the maximum of all profiles, and profile.TimeNanos will be the earliest nonzero one.

Parse parses a profile and checks for its validity. The input may be a gzip-compressed encoded protobuf or one of many legacy profile formats which may be unsupported in the future.

####
      func [ParseTracebacks](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22rc1:src/internal/profile/legacy_profile.go;l=252) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#ParseTracebacks)

  ParseTracebacks parses a set of tracebacks and returns a newly populated profile. It will accept any text file and generate a Profile out of it with any hex addresses it can identify, including a process map if it can recognize one. Each sample will include a tag "source" with the addresses recognized in string format.

Aggregate merges the locations in the profile into equivalence classes preserving the request attributes. It also updates the samples to point to the merged locations.

####
      func (*Profile) [CheckValid](https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/go1.22rc1:src/internal/profile/profile.go;l=241) [¶](https://pkg.go.dev#Profile.CheckValid)

  CheckValid tests whether the profile is valid. Checks include, but are not limited to:

- len(Profile.Sample[n].value) == len(Profile.value_unit)
- Sample.id has a corresponding Profile.Location

| Package intern lets you make smaller comparable values by boxing a larger comparable value (such as a 16 byte string header) down into a globally unique 8 byte pointer. | |
| Package lazyregexp is a thin wrapper over regexp, allowing the use of global regexp variables without forcing them to be compiled at init. | |
| Package lazytemplate is a thin wrapper over text/template, allowing the use of global template variables without forcing them to be parsed at init. | |
| Package nettrace contains internal hooks for tracing activity in the net package. | |
| Package obscuretestdata contains functionality used by tests to more easily work with testdata that must be obscured primarily due to golang.org/issue/34986. | |

| Package race contains helper functions for manually instrumenting code for the race detector. | |
| Package reflectlite implements lightweight version of reflect, not using any package except for "runtime", "unsafe", and "internal/abi" | |

| Package singleflight provides a duplicate function call suppression mechanism. | |

| Package testenv provides information about what functionality is available in different testing environments run by the Go team. | |
